title: Guardian Policy Publication Log
description: JSON Schema for publications.json sidecar files. These files are written and appended by the record-publication script — never edited by hand.

policy_id.description: Must match the id field in the sibling policy.yml.

entries.description: Append-only list of publication events, oldest first. Each entry is written by record-publication.js immediately after the Guardian publish action completes.

network.description: Hedera network the policy was published to.

version.description: Policy version (from policy.yml) at the time of publication.

ipfs_timestamp.description: IPFS timestamp returned by Guardian's publish API. Stored as a string to preserve nanosecond precision.

hedera_topic_id.description: Hedera Consensus Service topic ID used to anchor the policy (optional — not always returned by older Guardian versions).

published_by.description: Organization or Guardian account name that performed the publish action.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when record-publication.js wrote this entry (UTC).

notes.description: Optional free-text annotation for this publication event (e.g. 'Initial mainnet go-live', 'Hotfix for schema validation bug').
